propositions: gerrit-verify.yaml's monolithic build-and-test job hand-copies the gate+suite command set that test.yml runs, and a copy-sync guard polices the drift.

A new reusable workflow_call file _build-and-test.yml is added defining three jobs (lint, pip-audit, test matrix) with gerrit-refspec-parameterized checkout and no secrets, mirroring _optionality.yml.

test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml both delegate to the single reusable _build-and-test.yml so drift is impossible by construction, with gerrit's reusable-call job still named build-and-test and needed by vote.

All five test_ci_workflow_parity.py functions are rewritten or retargeted to the single-source invariant, preserving the pre-commit SKIP and optionality-contract safety guards while replacing copy-sync checks with delegation checks.
test_workflow_names.py is updated to cover _build-and-test.yml as 'Build and Test (reusable)'.
